vision.name: Frieza
vision.text:
(You cannot win by MPPV if you advance a personality level with this [Instant] Power.)
[Continuous]: Your first successful attack each combat gains "HIT: Destroy an opponent's Ally and raise your anger 1 level."
[Instant] POWER: Use when entering combat. Search your Life Deck for 7 Named cards and banish them to advance your MP 1 level.
POWER: [Attack] Energy attack.
DAMAGE: 2 life cards.
